generated.title: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Southern Panama: Quick Version | Next Huge Quake #shorts
generated.description:
A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck southern Panama on October 9, 2026 at 17:56 UTC, 12 km WSW of Pitaloza Arriba, at a depth of about 12.6 km (USGS, reviewed solution). USGS PAGER issued an orange alert and more than 1,950 "Did You Feel It?" reports were submitted. USGS did not flag a tsunami for this event.

This is a shorter, faster-paced cut of our earlier Panama Short, with the same event data.

Data may be revised as USGS updates the event.
Event page: https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us6000u18k
Stay informed. Stay prepared.
